The '''Great Cueva Expanse''', often referred to as the '''Cueva Desert''' and the '''Cueva Badlands''',<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> was an enormous field of crater holes that covered almost the entire northern hemisphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]].
